name: soft spots of an amorphous solid under shear
question: Does a cyclically sheared amorphous solid return to the same configuration when the strain comes back to an earlier turning point?
assumptions: Soft spots are elements with two states and a loop of their own, with half-widths uniform between 0.1 and 0.6
They interact through elastic fields of either sign: half of the couplings between neighbours on a square lattice are negative
A soft spot is switched forward by positive or by negative strain: the strain acts on it with a random sign
The strain changes slowly; thermal activation is neglected

provenance.source: interacting hysterons: M. van Hecke, Phys. Rev. E 104, 054608 (2021)
